next.reason: 1985: 'Within a declarative procedure, there must be no reference to any nondeclarative procedures.'; 2023: 'there shall be no reference to any nondeclarative procedures except in a RESUME statement.'. Same prohibition, but 2023 adds an exception: a RESUME statement in a declarative may reference nondeclarative procedures, a case the 1985 rule forbade outright.
